caption: See how deterministic taxonomy scoring weights required terms double. Role match in JobRez is fully deterministic, using a curated technology taxonomy with aliases, whole-word matching, required terms weighted double and preferred terms once, with no cloud AI and no external verification. Each branch is copied and tailored per role, then scored against the posting in Job DNA. Build your master resume at jobrez.com.
altText: Kinetic reel showing deterministic taxonomy scoring.
